body: Deep-dive-generated forward test (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Live deep dive #4, company drawn at random from pharma/healthcare + IT services names in the Rs 1,000-20,000 cr band (method test, L9/L21). Probability 0.15 (naive base rate 0.25) that: IMCL files (Reg-30, results note or AR) that the lease of the hospital land from the Government of NCT of Delhi has been renewed or extended (any tenor, any terms), or the Supreme Court orders a renewal on stated terms, between 24-Nov-2026 and 30-Nov-2027. Our reasoning: GNCTD's 27-Jan-2026 affidavit opposes renewal; the case has run since 2009; no disclosure of progress since 09-Feb-2026; the company has not even disclosed the expiry. Courts rarely close such matters within a year. Naive base: [EST] a dispute open ~3.3 years since expiry with an active Supreme Court bench: a ~25%/yr resolution hazard, all resolutions assumed renewals. Resolution: YES if an NSE/BSE filing or a Supreme Court order dated 24-Nov-2026..30-Nov-2027 states the lease has been renewed/extended or directs renewal on stated terms; NO otherwise (including continued pendency). Source: NSE/BSE announcements (INDRAMEDCO); SC case SLP(C) 29482/2009. Resolve by 2027-11-30; score with Brier vs the base rate.
